durability: synchronous=on; fsync enabled; default crash-clean file ownership
notes: Diagnostic workloads, not the canonical benchmark suite. Cold open includes open/query/close with a warm OS page cache. Startup includes process launch and SELECT 1. Checksum rendering is inside timed drains. Allocation totals include managed runtime/background work. No forced GC.

setup: CREATE TABLE t (id i32 PRIMARY KEY, v i64)
INSERT INTO t SELECT i, i::i64 * 2 FROM generate_series(1, 4096) AS g(i)

cases.name: point
cases.sql: SELECT id, v FROM t WHERE id = 1024

cases.name: range
cases.sql: SELECT id, v FROM t WHERE id BETWEEN 1000 AND 1100 ORDER BY id

cases.name: join
cases.sql: SELECT count(*), sum(a.v + b.v) FROM t a JOIN t b ON a.id = b.id

cases.name: sort
cases.sql: SELECT id, v FROM t ORDER BY v DESC, id LIMIT 100

cases.name: rollback
cases.sql: UPDATE t SET v = v + 1 WHERE id = 1024

cases.name: durable
cases.sql: UPDATE t SET v = v + 1 WHERE id = 1024

cases.name: cold_open
cases.sql: SELECT id, v FROM t WHERE id = 1024
